properties.name: THE SWEEP — 3 of 181 tools accept a reply budget, and at least 9 read tools exceed the 30,000-char default unbounded, the worst by 490x
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-09-13 against the live server holding reflow2's own 4,403-node design, by calling every tool that takes no required arguments and counting the bytes on the wire. This is the sweep fact:compare-designs-has-no-reply-budget-2026-09-13 demanded before anything was fixed — "the honest fix asks which OTHER read tools return an unbounded reply, and answers that before touching this one."

THE SURFACE: 181 tools. THREE accept budget_chars — detect_gaps, reviewed_gaps, topic_report. Everything else is unbounded by construction.

EXCEEDING THE 30,000-CHAR DEFAULT, UNBOUNDED (bytes on the wire):

    14,755,103  export_graph          492x   (see note — arguably exempt)
       126,377  confirmation_ledger     4.2x
       118,246  describe_schema         3.9x
        89,238  invalidated_findings    3.0x
        76,155  evidence_report         2.5x
        61,669  get_instructions        2.1x
        57,449  detect_defects          1.9x
        34,319  export_surface          1.1x
        30,489  list_skills             1.0x  (at the line)

    plus compare_designs, which takes arguments and so is not in this table —
    the originally reported instance, at 9-16 MB on two exports.

⚠️ ONE SURPRISE THAT IS NOT A TOOL WITHOUT A BUDGET: reviewed_gaps returned 76,155 bytes WITH its default 30,000 budget applied. So the bound is real but it bounds the report JSON rather than the delivered payload, and escaping plus the envelope carry it past 2.5x. Whatever is done here, "has budget_chars" must not be read as "fits" — that is the same gap between claim and behaviour this design keeps finding.

📌 export_graph IS A DIFFERENT CASE and should not be lumped in. Its job IS the whole document; a truncated export is not a smaller answer, it is a corrupt one. It needs streaming or a file path, not a character budget. It is listed because it is the largest and because it is the same payload that drives fact:the-servers-resident-memory-is-export-retention-not-rocksdb-2026-09-13.

WHY THE COUNT MATTERS MORE THAN ANY ONE ROW: the failure this bound exists to stop is the CLIENT refusing the reply, at which point the session sees harness text and reflow2 never gets to suggest narrowing. Nine tools can do that today, and the three that cannot are the three somebody fixed one at a time after meeting each one. That is the instance-not-class pattern fact:the-parallel-batch-class-recurred-because-only-its-instance-was-fixed already records on this project — visible here as 3 fixed against 178 not.

⭐ THE PRIMITIVE ALREADY EXISTS: reflow2_core::detect::DEFAULT_REPLY_BUDGET_CHARS, used by the three bounded tools. Nothing new has to be designed; the work is applying it, and deciding what each tool withholds first — which is a per-tool judgement, not a mechanical edit, because a budget that drops the wrong half makes a shorter answer a quieter one.

WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED: only the 38 no-argument read tools were measured, so the 143 tools requiring arguments are unmeasured and compare_designs is the only one of them known to be large. Sizes are for THIS design; a bigger graph moves every row up and a small one may put several under the line. No fix is implemented.
